text:
Hey everyone :)

My partner (not Israeli) and I (Israeli) are starting to prepare all the documents for applying for the partner visa (shared life for now)

We thought that I’ll apply here online and visit her after a while 

We’ll be abroad together until the interview (I’ll wait for them to schedule it before i leave or I'll do short visits in the meantime) — is that something that is possible? Has anyone done something like that?

Is visiting your partner during the waiting time for the first step of the gradual process possible?

I’m afraid that if I’m abroad for a time like a month or more, they will cancel the application or something.
